main_body: A synthetic blob of flat brown shapes: a large brown mass with a smaller tan block on the right and a smaller brown box on the left, all with black outlines. No readable top surface or front face.
top_band: none (column x=15 is one flat brown run of 21 rows, L=63, under a 1-row black outline; no lighter horizontal band)
evidence: The column scan at x=15 shows a single flat brown run (rows 1-21) with no lighter top band, no edge line and no step to a separate front face. Only a few tan highlight pixels appear. The shapes read as flat silhouettes in front view, so there is no 3/4 top surface and the drawing fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours and a median of 3 colours per tile, against 17-20 and 38-40 colours in the references. Flat-fill coverage is 52%, against 13% and 0% in the references. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line. It has large flat brown areas with no grain, only 2 tonal steps, and no material shading. It is far thinner than the Beodeul references.
